messages:
lina: morning — observability alert: huge spike in 5xx from hosted inference API since 10:02 UTC. rolling canary 'release-2026.03.14-canaryA' currently at 10%.
ops-bot: Alert: gateway_5xx_rate increased 18x for service=hosted-inference, pod=runtime-canary-3, metric_window=5m
kevin: i'm looking. canary started at 09:58, config flag flip rolled in: enable_prefix_cache=false for canary. that's suspicious.
maya: CS is getting a handful of SEV2 escalations — customers seeing timeouts and 502s during inference calls. one customer reported token billing continues despite errors.
sam: can we confirm if it's a runtime crash vs gateway rejection? any 5xx logs from runtime?
kevin: here's the top errors from runtime logs (last 5m):
```
2026-03-14T10:03:05Z runtime-canary-3 ERROR upstream_timeout: kv-cache-miss-thrashing
2026-03-14T10:03:07Z runtime-canary-3 ERROR rpc_deadline_exceeded
2026-03-14T10:03:09Z gateway ERROR 502 Bad Gateway: upstream read error
```
kevin: looks like disabling prefix cache caused enormous KV reads, increasing latency, hitting gateway timeouts.
elaine: we need rollback. can we cut canary and redeploy stable to 0%? what's the safe rollback plan?
sam: plan: scale canary replicas to 0, redeploy routing to stable (release-2026.03.13-stable), and re-enable caching flag. Also post a CS update.
deploy-bot: Received rollback request by @elaine. Rolling traffic: release-2026.03.13-stable -> 100% over 2m.
ops-bot: Deploy event: routing change applied at 10:11 UTC. starting traffic shift.
lina: executing hotfix runbook steps: 1) pin canary traffic to 0, 2) reconcile configmap on runtime nodes, 3) monitor latency and 5xx. running now.
kevin: updating runtime config: set enable_prefix_cache=true across region-us-east-1.
kevin: applied configmap change at 10:12, rolling restart triggered for runtime nodes in canary ring.
support-bot: CS note: draft message to affected customers: "We experienced elevated 5xx errors between 10:02-10:12 UTC due to a canary config change. Traffic has been rolled back and we're monitoring. We're investigating billing impacts — please DM if you saw charges for failed requests."
maya: sending that to customers now. tagging accounts that filed tickets.
ops-bot: alert: gateway_5xx_rate dropping, 5m-window now 2x baseline at 10:15.
lina: visible error rate back to baseline by 10:18. final check: traces show KV read latency dropped after cache re-enable.
kevin: root cause hypothesis: mis-scoped config flag pushed to canary turned off prefix caching causing high KV-access churn and timeouts at the serving runtime, leading to gateway 502/504s. will open a PR to add a safer rollout gating and a config schema validation.
sam: immediate actions: 1) rollback complete, 2) postmortem owner assigned (@kevin), 3) notify billing team to audit any failed-request charges. long-term: changeflag rollout docs + guard rails.
elaine: thanks all. CS asked for ETA on postmortem, aiming EOD today. I'll coordinate.
maya: customers replied :+1: appreciate quick turnaround. closing thread when postmortem published.
